Free-Standing Sign: Any non moveable sign not affixed to a building. Monument Sign: A free-standing business sign with a base width of at least eighty percent of the width of the sign cabinet or sign face. Projecting Sign: A sign that is wholly or partly dependent upon a building for support and that projects more than twelve inches from such building.
